before_gateway: printf '%s' "$1" | runuser -u orbit -- env -C apps/gateway php ../../tools/swamp-proof-guest/gateway.php fixture
clean_target:
command -v wg-quick >/dev/null || DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q wireguard-tools >/dev/null; umask 077; mkdir -p /etc/wireguard; rm -f /etc/wireguard/.orbit.conf.rollback; printf '[Interface]
Address = 10.99.0.1/24
ListenPort = 51820
PrivateKey = %s
' "$(wg genkey)" > /etc/wireguard/orbit.conf; systemctl enable wg-quick@orbit >/dev/null 2>&1; systemctl restart wg-quick@orbit
